class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackOpus
class.brief_description: Decodes queued Opus packets for playback.
class.description: The playback object returned by AudioStreamOpus through AudioStreamPlayer. Each instance owns one Opus episode, including its decoder, PCM ring and Speex output resampler.

method.name: available_space_frames
method.description: Returns unused capacity in decoded audio frames.

method.name: get_tail_max
method.description: Returns the peak magnitude in the most recently decoded [param frame_count] PCM frames. Returns zero when the requested history is unavailable.

method.name: get_decode_errors
method.description: Returns the number of Opus packets which failed to decode since playback started.

method.name: get_frame_number_actually_in_speaker
method.description: Estimates the playback-local decoded source frame currently audible at the speaker. The estimate follows the consumed PCM position and compensates for Speex input latency, time since the last Godot mix, and the audio driver's output latency. It is negative while the corresponding virtual frame precedes the first decoded frame.

method.name: get_last_decode_error
method.description: Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] after a successful decode, otherwise the latest negative libopus error code.

method.name: get_overflow_frames
method.description: Returns the number of unread frames overwritten by newer decoded frames.

method.name: get_tail_hash
method.description: Calculates a 32-bit FNV-1a hash over the most recently decoded [param frame_count] stereo PCM frames. Samples are quantized to signed 16-bit values before hashing. Returns [code]-1[/code] when the requested history is unavailable.

method.name: get_skips
method.description: Compatibility alias returning [method get_underflow_frames], or [method get_overflow_frames] when [param overflow] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_underflow_frames
method.description: Returns the number of output silence frames emitted because an active episode's decoded queue was empty.

method.name: finish_episode
method.description: Marks this episode's input as complete. The playback drains its PCM and resampler state, then stops itself. Returns the absolute decoded write position, or [code]-1[/code] if the episode was not receiving.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Provisions this playback for one episode after AudioStreamPlayer.play(). [param opus_frame_size] is the required decoded frames per channel for every packet and must represent a valid Opus duration. The PCM ring retains at least two seconds of decoded history. [param start_delay] schedules its first audible audio relative to initialization. If no footer arrives, an empty episode stops after [param stale_timeout] seconds without a packet.

method.name: push_opus_packet
method.description: Checks that the packet decodes to the configured frame size, then decodes it from [param begin], optionally using forward error correction. Returns the decoded frame count, or a negative libopus error code. When the ring is full, its oldest unread frames are overwritten and counted by [method get_overflow_frames] so new decoding can continue. Call this and the tail measurement methods from one producer thread only.

method.name: queue_length_frames
method.description: Returns the number of decoded frames waiting for playback.

method.name: set_sinewave_frames
method.description: Replaces decoded audio with a test sine wave for the given frames.
